name: Email Summary Bot
summary: A personal morning digest that reads unread Gmail messages from the last day, summarizes them with OpenRouter models, and sends the result to WhatsApp.
problem: A crowded inbox is a bad way to start a morning. The useful information is spread across unread threads, and opening each one to find the two lines that matter is a repeated tax.
solution: A Python job uses the Gmail readonly scope to collect unread messages from the last 24 hours, asks OpenRouter for a short summary, and falls back to a plain summary when the model is unavailable. The digest is delivered through CallMeBot to WhatsApp. OAuth tokens and API keys stay local and out of the repository.
